targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', aberto) AS time, count(*) AS volume FROM locaiops.incidentes_raw GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Violação de SLA por forma de abertura (%)

targets.rawSql: SELECT aberto_por, round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN kpi_violado = 'SIM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS taxa_violacao_pct FROM locaiops.incidentes_raw WHERE entrou_kpi = 'SIM' GROUP BY aberto_por
